Class InventoryManager

java.lang.Object
inventory.InventoryManager
public class InventoryManager extends Object
Holds all items and implements add, view, update and delete with validation.

      public void updateItem(int id, String name, String quantity, Status status)
      Updates an existing item.
      Parameters:
      id - id of the item to update
      name - new name
      quantity - new quantity text
      status - new status, or null to set it automatically from quantity
      Throws:
      NoSuchElementException - if no item has this id
      IllegalArgumentException - if the new input is invalid or the name is taken
